_doc: Kalshi × Polymarket Arb Bot V6 (hold-to-expiry) — Configuration. Copy to config.json and fill in your values. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the bot.
_doc_mode: Trading mode. 'paper' = simulate trades, fetch live prices but never place real orders (default, no credentials needed). 'live' = place real orders. If mode is 'live' but credentials are missing the bot automatically falls back to paper.
_doc_min_edge_pct: Minimum edge percentage required to trigger a trade. 0.001 = 0.1% edge after fees. Raise to be more selective; lower to trade more frequently. Edge = (1.0 - entry_cost_per_contract) / entry_cost_per_contract.
_doc_max_contracts: Maximum number of contracts to accumulate in a single arbitrage trade. The depth-walk stops as soon as adding one more contract would exceed this cap.
_doc_scan_interval_seconds: Seconds between full scan cycles when running in 'run' mode.
_doc_pairs_per_cycle: Max pairs to scan per cycle. Pairs with open positions are always scanned first, then the rest rotate so every pair gets checked evenly over time.
_doc_max_workers: Number of parallel threads used to fetch orderbook data. Higher = faster scans, but too high will trigger 429 rate-limit errors from Kalshi. 10 is a safe default.
_doc_print_market_status: Print a one-line market snapshot for every pair on each scan cycle, even when no arb is found. Useful for monitoring. Set to false to suppress.
_doc_play_sounds: Play audio notifications on trade entry and exit. Requires entry.wav and exit.wav in the src/ directory.
_doc_skip_multi_outcome: When true, pairs with 3 or more Polymarket outcomes are silently skipped each scan cycle rather than evaluated.
_doc_exit_enabled: Enable exit/close logic for open positions. When true, open positions are monitored and sold at bids when the exit rule is met.
_doc_exit_target_total_price: Target combined bid-quote total for YES+NO to trigger an early exit (e.g. 0.99 means sell when yes_bid + no_bid >= 0.99). V6 holds to expiry by default — settlement pays $1/contract, so this is only used for early-exit scanning.
_doc_pairs_input_mode: Pairs input mode. 'excel' = load from pairs_file (default, supports Polytoken merge). 'csv' = load from the newest file in input_files_dir each cycle; hot-reloads automatically when a newer file appears.
_doc_input_files_dir: Directory where daily CSV or Excel pairs files are dropped. The bot will automatically use the newest .csv, .xlsx, or .xls in this folder, overriding pairs_file.
_doc_pairs_file: Path to the Excel (.xlsx) or CSV pairs file. Required columns: pair_id, kalshi_ticker, polymarket_market_slug, resolution_date. Optional: polymarket_yes_token_id, polymarket_no_token_id, poly_outcomes_json, poly_token_ids_json, poly_primary_outcome, poly_event_url, active.
_doc_user_pairs_dirs: One path or a list of paths to Polytoken per-user pairs directories. Each directory is scanned for {username}/pairs.csv files at startup; new rows are merged into pairs_file (deduped by poly_market_id + kalshi_market_id) and each CSV is cleared afterward.
_doc_position_file: JSON file that stores currently open positions across restarts.
_doc_entry_log: File where entry trades are logged (one JSON object per line, appended).
_doc_exit_log: File where exit trades are logged (one JSON object per line, appended).
_doc_opportunities_log: File where every detected arbitrage opportunity is logged, including Kalshi and Polymarket market URLs and the full slippage breakdown.
_doc_expired_log: File where pairs past their resolution_date are permanently logged. Once logged they are never fetched again unless removed from this file.
_doc_failed_log: File where pairs that fail to fetch are permanently logged. Skipped for the entire session — remove from this file to retry.
_doc_bad_log: File where same-side/inverted pairs are permanently logged. Remove a pair from this file to retry it.
_doc_fees: Fee formulas as math expressions. Variables: p = contract price (0–1), q = 1−p, c = number of contracts.
_doc_fees_polymarket: Polymarket fee rate is fetched dynamically via the fee-rate endpoint per token ID. Formula here is used for validation only.

kalshi._doc: Kalshi taker fee. round_up_to_cent=true matches Kalshi's actual billing.

polymarket._doc: Formula is required for config validation only; runtime uses live fee-rate endpoint.

_doc_kalshi: Kalshi API credentials. Leave blank for paper trading — market data is publicly accessible without a key.

kalshi._doc_api_key: Your Kalshi API key ID (from Kalshi account → Settings → API).
kalshi._doc_private_key_base64: RSA private key in base64-encoded PEM format. Encode with: base64 -w0 your_private_key.pem (Linux/Mac) or [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('key.pem')) (PowerShell).
kalshi._doc_base_url: Kalshi API base URL. Leave blank to use the default production endpoint.

_doc_polymarket: Polymarket CLOB credentials. Leave blank for paper trading — orderbook data is publicly accessible without a key.

polymarket._doc_private_key: Ethereum wallet private key (starts with 0x). Used for signing orders.
polymarket._doc_clob_creds: CLOB API credentials — generate at clob.polymarket.com after connecting your wallet.
polymarket._doc_urls: Polymarket API base URLs. Leave blank to use the default production endpoints.
